cv.name: Grace Ho
cv.headline: Clinical Nurse – Intensive Care | Emergency background
cv.summary: Registered nurse with seven years in acute care across emergency and intensive care in Sydney. Calm under pressure, a regular preceptor for new graduates and interested in moving into a clinical nurse specialist role.

experience.title: Clinical Nurse – Intensive Care Unit
bullets: Care of ventilated and post-cardiac surgery patients in a 24-bed ICU
Preceptor for graduate nurses and transition-to-specialty staff
Team leader on night shift for a pod of six beds
Contributed to a pressure-injury audit that cut hospital-acquired injuries in the unit by a third

experience.title: Registered Nurse – Emergency Department
bullets: Triage and care of adult patients in a busy metropolitan ED
Completed advanced life support and trauma nursing courses

experience.title: Graduate Registered Nurse
bullets: Rotations in surgical and medical wards

education.degree: Graduate Certificate in Intensive Care Nursing
